notes.sessionsCreated: Sessions created already counts the sessions finalized polls produced, so it is never added to polls created.
notes.proposals: Proposals is the confirmation denominator: fixed sessions with no originating poll, plus polls. A finalized poll counts once, never twice.
notes.repeat: Organizers who started recently have had less of the window left to schedule again, which pushes the rate down on its own — read it beside the raw counts.

repeat.heading: Repeat scheduling
repeat.window: Scheduled again within {{days}} days of a first creation

users.heading: User management
users.searchLabel: Search by username or display name

ban.title: Ban this account?
ban.body: The account is signed out everywhere, can no longer sign in, and stops appearing in lookup and discovery. Its sessions, polls and history stay exactly as they are.

unban.title: Lift the ban?
unban.body: The account can sign in and appear in lookup and discovery again.

removeContent.title: Ban and remove this account's content?
removeContent.warning: Removing content cannot be undone, and lifting the ban later brings none of it back.
removeContent.body: Along with the ban, this cancels the account's sessions that have not started, expires its open polls, drops its future participation and pending join requests, and cancels its reminders. Completed history, friendships and blocks are left untouched.
removeContent.acknowledge: I understand the content removal is permanent.
removeContent.done: The account is banned and its content removed.

codes.scope_contended: Someone else changed this account's data while the request was running. Nothing was applied — try again.
codes.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
codes.transient_conflict: The request ran into a conflict. Try again.
